appearance: Folds in the wall or flange
usual_cause: Blank holder force too low; flange unsupported
usual_remedy: Increase blank holder pressure; adjust draw radius; add draw beads

appearance: Split at the die radius or in the wall
usual_cause: Ratio exceeds the material limit; die radius too tight; clearance too small; friction too high
usual_remedy: Add a redraw; open the die radius; correct clearance; improve lubrication
Accept and trim; change material or rolling direction; adjust blank shape

appearance: Wall too thin at the radius
usual_cause: Die radius too tight; excessive tension
usual_remedy: Increase die radius; add a redraw; anneal

appearance: Diameter or shape relaxes after forming
usual_cause: Elastic recovery worse in high-strength material
usual_remedy: Compensate tool dimensions; restrike; change material
Polish the die radius; re-coat or re-polish tooling; review lubricant

usual_cause: Punch radius too small; too little material available
usual_remedy: Increase punch radius; enlarge the blank
